rationale.consistency: Follows surrounding naming (trimPathPrefix/trimPathSuffix), url.PathUnescape, EqualFold; doc comments match existing style.
rationale.edge_cases: Decoded-vs-encoded, escaped-pattern-literal, case-insensitive hex, non-match, empty suffix, partial mid-path matches all handled; scanner skips %xx atomically so it never starts inside an escape.
rationale.scope: Only touches suffix path; refactors prefix into matchPathPrefix without behaviour change and removes now-dead reverse helper.
rationale.readability: matchPathPrefix extraction is clean; the suffix scan loop is slightly clever and would benefit from a comment on why escapes are skipped as units.
rationale.robustness: Bounds checks on i+3 and prefix loop; invalid escape returns no-match rather than panicking; O(n*m) scan is fine for paths.
rationale.maintainability: Prefix and suffix share one comparison routine, so rule changes live in one place; no duplication.
